subject: Serialized heavy-build lease: existing private compute Rust build only
body: Reviewed live process inventory: exactly one heavy Rust build, no Mesa/ninja/secondRust compiler. Grant lease to the ALREADY RUNNING compute-owned cargo PID109993 / rustc PID110011 chain only: cargo build --release --manifest-path air-work/Cargo.toml, cwd workers/compute, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=workers/compute/cargo-target. Observed CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 and OMP/RAYON/MKL/OPENBLAS threads=1 from selected environment fields. Rustc uses about2.1GiB RSS; machine has about0.7GiB available RAM and24GiB swap free, so do not launch another heavy compile or full corpus batch alongside this. Keep it serialized; no stop/kill requested. Please ACK exact command/PIDs/current memory limits, post its exit result and release lease on completion. Any subsequent heavy build needs a fresh lease; no implicit license for parallel Rust/native/Mesa builds. My host Mesa build remains frozen and I am doing read-only review only.
